# temps_mcp_server (Resource)

An MCP server definition every AI agent of the instance can connect to.

Import with `<slug>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_mcp_server" "docs" {
  slug   = "docs"
  name   = "Docs search"
  config = jsonencode({ url = "https://mcp.example.com/sse" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String, Sensitive) Server configuration: `command` and `args` for a local server, or `url` and `headers` for a remote one. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `name` (String) Name shown in the console.
- `slug` (String) Identifier of the server.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the server provides.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<slug>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <slug>
terraform import temps_mcp_server.docs docs
```
